title: Materialize and transcribe First Alert WAVs
description: Extract the 2,000 WAV files from First Alert ZIP batches into the corpus, import them as Biblicus audio items, reindex, and run STT extraction when a configured backend is available.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Started STT extraction work. Local environment has Deepgram and OpenAI client packages installed, but no DEEPGRAM_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY in the shell; faster-whisper is not installed. Proceeding first with WAV materialization and corpus import, then extraction will be attempted only if a configured backend is available.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: WAV materialization and import completed: 2,000 WAV files imported; first-alert catalog now has 2,080 entries (40 ZIP, 40 CSV, 2,000 audio/x-wav). STT backend check: OpenAI is configured, Deepgram has no key, faster-whisper is unavailable. Duration probe found 271.43 hours of audio; full hosted transcription is a paid API run, so preparing an OpenAI-ready compressed corpus before starting API calls.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Prepared OpenAI-ready corpus. Converted 2,000 WAV files to 16 kHz mono MP3 under corpora/first-alert-openai-stt/imports/first-alert-mp3, imported them into corpora/first-alert-openai-stt, and reindexed. Verification: first-alert catalog has 2,080 entries; first-alert-openai-stt catalog has 2,000 audio/mpeg entries; largest MP3 is 13.65 MB; no MP3 files exceed 25 MB. Full STT run is blocked pending explicit approval for about 271.43 hours of paid OpenAI transcription.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Checking ../Biblicus-old for Deepgram configuration without printing secret values.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Found Deepgram configuration in ../Biblicus-old/.biblicus/config.yml. Secret value was not printed. Current project remains unconfigured until that config is copied or the key is exported for the extraction process.
